LanguageData.MOTS_RemoveSchematics_Desc: Prevents Medieval Overhaul from adding research schematics.
LanguageData.MOTS_LoadingCart_Label: Enable loading cart for scribe table
LanguageData.MOTS_LoadingCart_Desc: Adds back the old loading card for the scribe table.
LanguageData.MOTS_BetterVents_Desc: Allows you to build wooden and stony vents.
LanguageData.MOTS_DeconstructScrap_Desc: Allows you to deconstruct Medieval Overhaul scrapfields.
LanguageData.MOTS_FlickFireplace_Desc: Allows you to toggle Medieval Overhaul fireplaces on and off.
LanguageData.MOTS_Doormats_Desc: Medieval Overhaul cloth and leather rugs act as doormats.
LanguageData.MOT_ModMenuNewsLetter_Text: Medieval Overhaul: Toggleable Stuff has its own mod menu. You can change toggleable patches there. Please note that you might have to re-enable some of your previously activated settings due to these changes.
